```yaml
name: Codex Review - Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [develop, epic]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  notify-code-owner:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get PR info
        id: pr_info
        run: |
          echo "PR_NUMBER=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "PR_AUTHOR=${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "PR_TITLE=${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Extract code owners
        id: codeowners
        run: |
          # Get the list of files changed in this PR
          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD)
          
          # Create a temporary file to store unique code owners
          touch /tmp/codeowners_list.txt
          
          # For each changed file, find its code owner(s) using CODEOWNERS
          while IFS= read -r file; do
            if [[ -n "$file" ]]; then
              # Find code owners for this file
              CODEOWNERS=$(grep -E "^$file\s+" .github/CODEOWNERS | awk '{print $2}' | tr '\n' ' ')
              if [[ -n "$CODEOWNERS" ]]; then
                echo "$CODEOWNERS" >> /tmp/codeowners_list.txt
              fi
            fi
          done <<< "$CHANGED_FILES"
          
          # Get unique code owners
          UNIQUE_CODEOWNERS=$(sort /tmp/codeowners_list.txt | uniq | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//')
          echo "UNIQUE_CODEOWNERS=$UNIQUE_CODEOWNERS" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Notify code owners
        if: env.UNIQUE_CODEOWNERS != ''
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { UNIQUE_CODEOWNERS } = process.env;
            const prNumber = ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }};
            const prTitle = ${{ toJSON(github.event.pull_request.title) }};
            const prAuthor = ${{ toJSON(github.event.pull_request.user.login) }};
            const repo = context.repo;

            // Format the message
            const message = `@${UNIQUE_CODEOWNERS} This PR (${prNumber}: ${prTitle}) requires your review. Please take a look at the changes.`;

            // Add comment to PR
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: prNumber,
              owner: repo.owner,
              repo: repo.repo,
              body: message
            });

            // Add reviewers to PR
            const reviewers = UNIQUE_CODEOWNERS.split(',').map(name => name.trim());
            await github.rest.pulls.requestReviewers({
              pull_number: prNumber,
              owner: repo.owner,
              repo: repo.repo,
              reviewers: reviewers
            });
```
